authority_snapshot.owner_target: VARIABLE COGNITIVE GRID + PERSISTENT DATABASE + CLAUDE CODE + strongest causally evidenced Global J-Space bridge
authority_snapshot.training_target: Qwen3.5-0.8B-class reusable cognitive-process substrate; runtime N variable; GRID10 benchmark-only

lifecycle.reason: Existing actionability/source-selection work asks whether an intervention changes the intended behavior and where steering vectors should be sourced. This delta adds a separate requirement: the intervention must not earn mechanism/J-Space credit merely by driving hidden states into an unnatural region that activates a dormant or off-manifold pathway.
lifecycle.moving_main_rule: If a later converged Trigger-2 ledger exists at admission time, this artifact is a method donor until explicitly re-entered against that successor.

external_research.source: Grant et al., Addressing divergent representations from causal interventions on neural networks, arXiv:2511.04638, 2025
external_research.finding: Common causal interventions can shift representations away from the target model's natural distribution; the authors distinguish harmless divergence from pernicious divergence that can activate dormant pathways, and study regularization toward natural distributions.
external_research.project_effect: A behavior-changing intervention is insufficient for positive J-Space mechanism credit unless intervention-distribution fidelity is measured at exact model/runtime/site identity.

external_research.source: Vogels et al., In-Distribution Steering: Balancing Control and Coherence in Language Model Generation, arXiv:2510.13285, 2025
external_research.finding: Adaptive steering based on representation-space distribution is reported to preserve stronger generation stability than fixed unadapted steering in the studied setting.
external_research.project_effect: Include a matched distribution-aware intervention control where technically feasible rather than treating fixed-strength steering as the only causal intervention family.

external_research.source: Ye et al., Where Steering Signals Come From: Activation Source Selection in Activation Steering, arXiv:2607.25270, 2026
external_research.finding: Holding downstream intervention fixed while varying source context/readout policy materially changes steering success across the reported models and tasks; execution-boundary source states are especially important.
external_research.project_effect: Distribution-fidelity testing must be crossed with source-policy testing because an apparently strong source policy may also differ in how far its intervention moves the target representation from natural states.

hypothesis.claim: Some apparently successful J-Space/activation interventions will change behavior primarily because they create out-of-distribution hidden states, so behavioral actionability alone can overstate reuse of the model's natural cognitive mechanism.

counterhypothesis.claim: A representation can move measurably away from the empirical natural-state cloud while remaining causally faithful, for example through null-space movement or within a behaviorally equivalent region; therefore distribution distance alone must not veto a valid intervention.

required_exact_identity: random seed and numerical environment where relevant

training_effect.rule: Do not turn steering success into positive J-Space labels until exact-checkpoint actionability, source-policy, provenance, holdout and intervention-distribution fidelity gates jointly pass.

architecture_effect.global_jspace: Strengthens the evidence ceiling: only causally useful and mechanistically distribution-faithful controls may be promoted as model-specific J-Space carriers.
architecture_effect.hyperposition: Preserve both explanations when actionability and distribution fidelity disagree: NATURAL_MECHANISM_CONTROL versus OOD_PATHWAY_ACTIVATION remain live alternatives until discriminated.
architecture_effect.variable_grid: No fixed N assumption is introduced; evaluation should include held-out N where the control semantics are intended to be grid-size invariant.
architecture_effect.database_boundary: No canonical truth or durable fact is inferred from activation geometry; exact state/evidence remains database-bound.

next_discriminator: On the first exact Qwen3.5-0.8B-class checkpoint/runtime admitted for J-Space causal testing, preregister one natural-state distribution statistic and threshold from frozen control data, then cross source policy x intervention strength on held-out families while measuring intended behavior, off-target behavior, reversibility/rescue and distribution shift. Preserve UNKNOWN rather than tuning the threshold after seeing target outcomes.
